messages:
maria: spotted a jump in invoice-preview tokens for tenant `green-co` at ~15:10 UTC right after we enabled routing fallback for the canary. preview shows duplicate token lines. anyone on metering?
sam: that sounds like classic fanout dupes. do we have request_fingerprint on those events?
maria: not consistently. proxy v1 events lack fingerprint; proxy v2 good. ingest-bot just emitted `ingest.dedupe.missing_fp` spike.
ingest-bot: WARN ingest.consumer batch=12021 missing_fp=1248 canary=canary/2026-03-23T15:09Z
sam: quick mitigation options: 1) revert fanout to atomic switch, 2) add fallback fingerprint in consumer using req_id+tenant+ts_ms, 3) mark canary previews and exclude them from invoice-preview aggregation until dedupe completes.
sre_lee: prefer (2) short-term. (3) will create analyst confusion. (1) is disruptive for rollout.
maria: risk: some clients don't send ts_ms, so ts only at second granularity -> false merges on retries. need to use ts_unix_ms when present, else include retry_count header if available.
sam: plan: consumer tries request_fingerprint; if missing, compute fp = req_id||"|"||tenant_id||"|"||coalesce(ts_ms, floor(ts_unix*1000))||"|"||coalesce(retry_count,0). tag events dedupe_hint=consensus-20260323. roll to 20% shards first.
ingest-bot: deploy triggered: metering-consumer/dedupe-fallback@canary shards=20 id=dc-20260323-15:30
maria: can we add a transient console note on invoice-preview: "Possible duplicate tokens during canary routing" when canary metadata present? stops finance paging ops.
sre_lee: yes, but only in preview UI, not final billing. i'll add alert gating: if duplicate_token_rate > 0.5% for 10m, page.
sam: patched consumer -> canary applied. initial telemetry shows duplicate token rate down ~90% in sampled window. still tiny tail where events have neither ts_ms nor retry_count.
maria: capturing sample ids for tail and will reach out to SDK team. opened tickets: PLAT-6900 (console preview note) and PLAT-6901 (proxy v1 add ts_ms/ fingerprint).
ingest-bot: INFO dedupe.metrics dedupe_rate=98.7% sample_window=5m
deploy-bot: deploy canary metering-consumer/dedupe-fallback completed id=dc-20260323-15:32
maria: thanks all, will monitor billing-emails channel and mute if console note reduces noise.
